deleteDialog.title: Delete this rental?
deleteDialog.body_one: This permanently deletes the rental, its criteria and {{count}} applicant with their documents. This can't be undone.
deleteDialog.body_other: This permanently deletes the rental, its criteria and {{count}} applicants with their documents. This can't be undone.
deleteDialog.bodySample: This removes the sample rental and its sample applicants.

closeDialog.title: Close this rental?
closeDialog.body: It moves to Closed. You can reopen it any time.

published.title: Rental criteria

check.C1: Income of at least {{multiple}}× the rent
check.C1share: Income of at least {{multiple}}× your share of the rent
check.C2: {{count}} months of rental or home-ownership history
check.C3: No eviction judgment in the past {{count}} years
check.C4: A previous landlord who would rent to you again
check.C5: No unpaid balance owed to a past landlord
check.C10: Criminal history: convictions in the past {{count}} years only, reviewed individually after a conditional offer

published.proofOfIncome: Proof of income (2 recent pay stubs, offer letter, or benefits / voucher letter)
